_: What the geometry cannot say. Everything structural — which sub-track is
the spine, where an option branches and rejoins, which waypoints belong to
which line — is worked out from the file by scripts/build-tracks.mjs.
What is left here is editorial, and it is per traveller as much as per
route: the day number in the itinerary, which hotel spur was actually
walked, which options are worth offering as a line of their own, and the
handful of waypoints that sit beside the route without being on it.
A new trip is its GPX files dropped in this folder plus an entry here.
Leave an entry out and the build says so rather than shipping it unnamed.

6a OPTION Cosgaya to Espinama.name: Day 2 Cosgaya to Fuente Dé (harder option)

7a_Fuente_De_High_Picos_circuit.gpx.name: Day 3 Fuente Dé High Picos Circuit

6c Avoiding Mt Calvaire.name: Day 2 Bera to Hondarribia (avoiding Mont du Calvaire)

7a Easier route.name: Day 3 Hondarribia to San Sebastián (easier, off the ridge)
